findings.title: Host lower‑casing alters matching semantics
findings.explanation: The added code lowercases the parsed host before matching it against `self.host_regex`. The original regex is compiled from the user‑provided host pattern and may be case‑sensitive. Lower‑casing the host can cause valid hosts that rely on case to no longer match, leading to incorrect routing behavior.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove the `.lower()` call or compile the regex with the `re.IGNORECASE` flag if case‑insensitive matching is intended.
